player_prompt.intro:
Keddaɣ ad tekkiɣ {player_id} ɣef Nim.
Alɣu-inek teddaɣ ad tekkiɣ ayyaw n yifassen aneggaru.
Deg krayat n yal ass, fayez pile iɣzifen, d aɣrez ayyawen seg-s.
Seqdec tawila '[pile quantity]', anda pile d aswir n upile, d quantity d uṭṭun n yifassen ara tekkiɣ.
Alaɣ, '[0 3]' ad yerrez 3 n yifassen seg upile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: ⵓⵔ ⵉⵜⵜⵢⴰⴼⴰ ⴽⵔⴰ ⵏ ⵓⵙⴽⴰⵔ ⵉⵣⵔⵉⵏ ⵉ ⵓⵙⵙⵎⵓⵜⵜⴳ. ⵙⵔⵙ "[pile quantity]".
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Aqeddac {player_id}, Aseqdec n uḍaɣar ur d-ittaɣ ara. Aḍaɣar {col} ur d-yella ara.
invalid_move.out_of_range: ⵓⴰ ⵢⵂⴰⵏ {pile_index} ⵏ ⴱⵉⵍⵍ ⵓⵔ ⵉⴾⵏⵢ ⴰⵛⵂⵔⵓⵜ.
invalid_move.non_positive: ⵉⵇⵏⴻⵏ ⴰⴷ ⵢⴰⴽⴽⵙ ⵢⴰⵏ ⵓⵏⴰⵡ ⵙ ⵉⵎⵉⴽ.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: Ur d-yefɣel ara {quantity} seg uḍaɣar {pile_index} (kan {pile_count} yella).

observation.removed_from_piles: Aqeddac {player_id} yefɣel [{pile_index} {quantity}], d-yefɣel {quantity} n t-ileqqiwen seg uḍaɣar {pile_index}.
